description: Get details of a specific calendar event by its event ID. Returns the full event (all attendees, reminders, conference data), with the description converted to plain text; use full for the original (often HTML) description.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

full.description: Keep the description exactly as stored (often multi-KB HTML from Zoom/scheduling tools) instead of converting it to plain text.

name: gws-mcp__calendar_get_event
